$comment: The secrets that live in a GitHub environment, not in the organization. An environment secret is read only by a job that runs in that environment, and both environments are limited to main. bin/env-secrets.sh sets one in every repository that has the environment, and bin/apply-repo-baseline.sh reports an organization secret that still names a repository. The release App's secrets and GITLEAKS_LICENSE stay organization secrets: their jobs run on any branch or tag.
